title: Waadaa Gadameessaa
intro: Golee callisaa onnee Waaqaaf of kenne keessatti waadaan qulqulluun ulfoofte. Kaaduun kun jireenya ammallee hafuura baafachuu hin dandeenye irratti kan xiyyeeffate si’a ta’u, raawwiin isaas adeemsa hambaa hafuuraa bara baraan ni jijjiira. Iccitii lubbuu waadaan ishee bara baraan sagalee ta’e keessa tarkaanfadhu.
clues: Mana quuqamuun beekamu keessa jiraachaa ture, kennaa Rabbiitti na dhiheessu hawween ture.
Waan na keessa dhokate ilaalchisee Gooftaa koo wajjin kakuu cimaa gale, guutummaatti tajaajila isaaf akkan kennu dhaadadhe.
Yeroon itti mul’atu yeroo ga’u wanti na argadhe waanan hin eegamne ta’us, dhimmicha nama Hundumaa Beekaaf imaanaa kenne.
Mucaa kootiif maqaa of kennuu argisiisu kenne, ishee fi sanyii ishee isa abaaramaa irraa eegumsa akka argatu nan kadhadhe.
Mucaan koo iddoo qulqulluu qulqulluu keessa, eeggumsa raajii hidda dhaloota Aaron irraa dhufe jala kaa’ame.
Intalli koo qulqullummaa isheetiin beekamtee dubartoota hunda caalaa filatamte, boodarra haadha raajii guddaa ta’us, osoo hin tuqamin hafte.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
